Three Simple Steps

How Personalization Works

  1. Pick your gear

    Choose the car seat, the floor hammock or the blanket, then the color that matches your vehicle.

  2. Add the name

    Type your dog's name on the product page and check the preview before you add it to the cart.

  3. We stitch it

    We embroider the name on your gear and ship it to you ready to use.
